title: Salts of Tree Bark
summary: Alchemy extract used to make Elixir of Barkskin.

fields.Recipe: Combine these salts with any Suspension to make Elixir of Barkskin.
fields.Result: Raises AC to at least 16 until Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
